original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹卡波埃塔南部金矿紧张局势引发冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 东赤道州政府证实，卡波埃塔南部县纳凯凯金矿区上周末发生冲突，称安全局势正逐步恢复正常。反对派全国救国阵线（NAS）则指控政府军对托波萨族青年发动报复性袭击，造成数名平民死亡。政府与反对派对事件经过和伤亡情况说法不一，目前信息仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Nakeke gold mining area of Kapoeta South County, Eastern Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 东赤道州政府证实卡波埃塔南部县纳凯凯金矿区发生冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Eastern Equatoria State Government has confirmed clashes in the Nakeke gold mining area of Kapoeta South County over the weekend

key_facts.fact: 政府称安全局势正逐步恢复正常
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: saying the security situation is gradually normalising

key_facts.fact: 冲突造成士兵和平民死亡、多人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: violence that killed soldiers and civilians and wounded several others

key_facts.fact: 反对派NAS指控政府军对托波萨族青年发动报复性袭击致数名平民死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the opposition National Salvation Front (NAS), which accused government forces of launching a reprisal attack against Toposa youth in the mining area

key_facts.fact: NAS声称约600名南苏丹人民国防军士兵从朱巴部署至纳凯凯
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NAS claimed that about 600 South Sudan People’s Defence Forces (SSPDF) soldiers had been deployed from Juba to Nakeke on October 31

key_facts.fact: 卡波埃塔-恩高罗公路沿线安全形势仍令人担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kapoeta-Ngauro road also remains a security concern

uncertainties: 政府与反对派NAS对冲突经过和伤亡情况说法不一，尚无法确认
NAS所称约600名士兵部署及数十人军事伤亡的说法尚未获独立证实
政府军是否实施报复性袭击及是否存在人权侵犯尚未证实
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
